_comment: Parameters established by hardware experiment, NOT from published Yamaha
documentation. The Data List lists Sequencer Setup (00 05 00) as a 22-byte
bulk block but publishes no parameter table for it -- the single gap in the
All 22 addresses were probed; exactly two respond to a Parameter Request.
Identified by: (a) the owner reading the front panel as 'external' while
00 05 0B held 01, matching index 1 of internal/external/auto; (b) accepted
value ranges -- 0B clamps at 2 (three values), 0C clamps at 1 (two values);
(c) the Quick Setup template block (00 6n) carries MIDI Sync then MIDI Clock
Out in adjacent slots 09/0A, the same order and adjacency seen here.
These are merged into parameters.json by tools/build_parameters.py and are
flagged with source: 'hardware' so they can be told apart from documented

parameters.name: MIDI Sync
parameters.notes: hardware-discovered; not in the published parameter tables. This is the LIVE setting; the same-named parameter at 00 6n is a Quick Setup template value.

parameters.name: MIDI Clock Out
parameters.notes: hardware-discovered; not in the published parameter tables. This is the LIVE setting; the same-named parameter at 00 6n is a Quick Setup template value.
